_note: PINNED to Remix Icon v4.8.0, the last Apache-2.0 release: v4.9.0 and later carry the custom 'Remix Icon License v1.0', which forbids redistribution as an icon pack. `version_check_url` names the v4.8.0 tag, never `releases/latest`. The licence guard is mandatory here: `licence` and `licence_sha256` both fail a sync whose License text changes. Category folders are slugged (`Game & Sports` -> `game-sports`). Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 3,188 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
name: icon-sets-remix
